INTRO
Drag a peg to lift and untangle the rope.
HOW TO PLAY

Free the ropes!

Hold any colored peg to lift the end. Drag the upper rope over the crossing to free it while you're dragging, then place the end onto an open socket.

Lower ropes cannot pass through upper ropes. Crossing out and back keeps the knot. Sealed gray sockets cannot be used.

Later levels add numbered destination rings, lettered switches, frozen ends, fragile sockets, and move budgets. Activate each matching switch to open its linked locks. Hints show the recorded solution, and every level is available in test mode.
